bsm_3.text: ♪ A slow funereal organ hymn, played in a suspiciously cheerful major key. ♪

bsm_6.text: Margaret, seventy-four, worked forty years so her family wouldn't have to worry.

bsm_10.text: The camera pulls back to reveal a gleaming reprint chamber, fogging gently at the seams.

bsm_11.text: For as little as forty credits a week, NextLife™ guarantees a full-body reprint within seventy-two hours of clinical death.

bsm_12.text: Same face. Similar personality. Legally, the same person.

bsm_13.text: Ask about our Basic, Premium, and "Please Don't Let Them Know I'm Gone Yet" tiers.

bsm_14.subtext: PREMIUMS CONTINUE AFTER DEATH VIA NEXT-OF-KIN GARNISHMENT

bsm_15.message: cuts to a reprinted Margaret, waving stiffly from a factory floor

bsm_16.text: I died in a machining accident on a Tuesday. NextLife had me back at that same machine by Friday.

bsm_17.text: The clock behind her reads a date that does not quite match the one on her paperwork.

bsm_18.text: NextLife™ is a resurrection-adjacent product, not a resurrection guarantee · Reprinted memories accurate to last successful backup, backups not guaranteed to be recent · Original body remains property of the estate until premiums are current · Garnishment continues for three (3) generations or until the debt is resolved, whichever the actuary prefers

description: Life-insurance parody: a resurrection assurance plan that guarantees a cheap reprint body and a lifetime — technically posthumous-lifetime — of continued premiums.
